reserves.name: Staked ZANO in the Freedom Dollar reserve wallet

sources.label: Freedom Dollar live reserve disclosure (last-updated 10/29/2026 6:37:27 PM)

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer's live dashboard was re-read on 2026-10-29 and carried its own last-updated stamp of 10/29/2026, 6:37:27 PM. It disclosed 1,534,832.53 ZANO at $3.814 ($5,853,851.26 of stated public reserves), 6,054,737 fUSD held in the reserve wallet, about 5.9M circulating and 12M minted fUSD, and a stated 0.98x coverage ratio. The issuer also publishes a view-only tracking seed for direct observation of the ZANO reserve wallet. The reserve-held fUSD is the protocol's own uncirculated supply rather than exogenous collateral, so the backing composition resolves to one ZANO category and the 100% slice weight is unchanged. The ZANO price decline and the move below 1.0x coverage (1.59x on 2026-09-21, 1.04x on 2026-10-27, 0.98x on 2026-10-29) are recorded as observed; sub-1.0x coverage is a verified-worse collateral finding rather than a composition change, and the slice retains its high risk tier.

providers.name: Freedom Dollar on-chain ZANO reserve wallet (staked on Zano)

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Reserves sit in an on-chain ZANO wallet staked on Zano rather than with a legal custodian, and the white paper asserts no corporate entity exists. The reserve wallet's key custody (single operator vs distributed control) is not publicly observable, and no legal segregation, insolvency-remoteness, or rehypothecation terms are published.
